prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: high-impact social sharing image for a premium interactive Atlas of Arrakis website, intended to be center-cropped to 1200x630.
Primary request: Create a dramatic, emotionally magnetic, original science-fiction desert portrait that instantly makes a general audience want to click. This is a visual for an atlas about geography, power, survival and spice on a fictional desert planet.
Scene/backdrop: an immense ochre desert during a violent golden-hour sandstorm. In the far right background, a colossal ring-mouthed sandworm erupts from the dunes, fully readable even at thumbnail size, throwing a luminous wall of sand into the air. Thin, elegant topographic contour lines and one orbital arc are subtly embedded in the sky and dunes.
Subject: an original adult desert woman in the left foreground, close three-quarter portrait, windblown dark scarf framing her face, weathered practical desert clothing, intense luminous deep-blue irises, a trace of sand on her skin, calm and fearless expression. She must be an original fictional person and not resemble any known actor or public figure.
Style/medium: premium cinematic editorial photography with refined scientific-atlas details; realistic skin and sand; original production design; polished campaign key art.
Composition/framing: very wide 1.91:1 landscape. The woman fills the left third, her eyes near the upper-left intersection. The giant worm fills the right third. Preserve a darker low-detail band across the bottom 22% for a short title overlay added later. Strong silhouettes, large readable shapes, immediate focal hierarchy. Keep faces and worm away from the outer 5% crop-safe margin.
Lighting/mood: fierce amber backlight, blue eyes as the only cool chromatic accent, luminous airborne dust, high contrast, awe, danger, intelligence and mystery.
Color palette: deep black-brown shadows, incandescent amber and copper, vivid but tasteful cobalt-blue eyes, cream highlights.
Materials/textures: tactile woven scarf, mineral sand, wind-carved skin texture, subtle paper grain, fine engraved cartographic lines.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, logos, borders, watermarks or user interface; no recognizable actors; no film-specific costumes, architecture or vehicles; no gore; no exposed sexuality; anatomically natural face and eyes; the sandworm must be unmistakably huge and readable in a small preview.
Avoid: muddy all-sepia tonal range, tiny subject, generic fantasy palace, duplicated facial features, cluttered map UI, horror aesthetics.
